company.name: Anubis Gaming
company.description:
With hundreds of millions of hardcore gamers and thousands of global tournaments each year, eSports have become one of the worlds biggest sports.

Each global region is represented by up to 3 teams every year in multi-million dollar international tournaments, except for the MENA region and Africa as a whole. Our objective is to represent the region, with what is currently Egypt's number one eSports team, on the international stage.

Our players deserve the chance to compete on the international stage, through their local/regional performances and content we will show the world why the region deserves a slot.

productsAndServices.description: A professional eSports team competing in various games such as League of Legends and CrossFire, representing African and MENA regions in competitive gaming tournaments.
